FlowBehavior.description:
A single customer-requested Contact Flow behavior, mapped to the
Amazon Connect blocks that implement it (with dependency ordering).

This is the unit the Contact Flow generator MUST realize in the flow JSON.

description.description: What the customer asked for, in their words
description.title: Description

blocks.description: Ordered Amazon Connect block Types that implement this behavior (e.g. ['UpdateContactCallbackNumber','TransferContactToQueue']). Order encodes dependency: each block's NextAction points to the next.
blocks.title: Blocks

depends_on.description: Other behaviors/blocks that must precede this one (e.g. 'dtmf_auth' before 'agent_escalation')
depends_on.title: Depends On

FlowBehavior.title: FlowBehavior

description:
Dedicated specification for the Contact Flow generator.

Unlike OperationSpec (which describes API business operations), this captures
the FLOW-level behaviors the customer requested — callback, queue transfers,
business-hours branching, escalation, DTMF auth — so the Contact Flow agent
builds from an explicit contract instead of inferring from chat. Each
behavior names the Connect blocks and their dependency order.

use_native_faq_retrieve.description: True → rely on Connect AI agent native Retrieve for FAQ (NO custom Lambda/API). False only when an external doc API was requested.
use_native_faq_retrieve.title: Use Native Faq Retrieve

use_native_escalation.description: True → agent escalation/end-call via native Return to Control (flow routing), NOT a custom Lambda/tool.
use_native_escalation.title: Use Native Escalation

behaviors.description: Ordered list of customer-requested flow behaviors to realize.
behaviors.title: Behaviors

notes.description: Free-text design notes for the flow generator
notes.title: Notes
